Theme

Money, work & business

interest noun

on money lent

also interest rate, at interest, lend at interest, borrow money at interest, lend money at interest, simple interest, compound interest, rate of interest, pay interest, principal, capital (money)

classical

Cic. Att. 4.15.7
Hor. Epod. 2.4: faenore omnī solūtus (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. interest
Traupman 164
Traupman 164: perpetuum faenus, simple interest
Traupman 333

faenus, faenoris n.

noun, third declension

interest on money lent

Lewis & Short prefers faenus to fēnus. To lend at interest, pecūniam faenorī dare (Traupman 333).

Other words

  • ūsūra, ūsūrae f. — interest; properly, the use of money lent

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Caes. BC 3.21: sine ūsūrīs (Lewis & Short); Cic. Sen. 51; M-O s.v. interest; Traupman 333

    Reckoned by the month: centēsimae, one per cent a month (see rate).

  • caput, capitis n. — principal, capital (as against the interest)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.1.11 (Lewis & Short); Hor. S. 1.2.14 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 365

  • sors, sortis f. — principal, capital bearing interest

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Plaut. Most. 3.1.122: et sors et faenus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 365

Examples

  • nec umquam sine ūsūrā reddit quod accēpit

    (the earth) never returns what it has received without interestCic. Sen. 51

  • faenus ex triente Īdibus Quīntīlibus factum erat bessibus

    on the Ides of July interest had gone up from a third to two thirds of a per cent a monthCic. Att. 4.15.7

  • pecūniam faenore accipere

    to borrow money at interestTraupman 164

  • pecūniam faenore dare

    to lend money at interestTraupman 164

  • ūsūram augēre (minuere)

    to increase (lower) interestTraupman 333

  • pecūniam faenorī dare

    to lend money at interestCic. Verr. 2.2.170: pecūniās hīs faenorī dabat (Lewis & Short s.v. faenus); Traupman 333

  • quadrantēs (trientēs, quīncūncēs, sēmissēs, centēsimae) ūsūrae

    3 (4, 5, 6, 12) per cent interest a yearTraupman 333

  • ūsūram pendere (+ dat.)

    to pay interest onTraupman 333

  • perpetuum faenus

    simple interestTraupman 333

  • dē capite ūsūrās dēdūcere

    to deduct the interest from the principalTraupman 365

See also rate, debt, bank, percent.
